item.description:
NVBeacon is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH with `nvidia-smi`, process exit alerts, and GPU idle notifications.
- Added Simplified Chinese. Choose it in **Settings → General → Language**, or keep **System** to follow your macOS preferred languages. - The GPU History window now points to **Settings → Monitoring** when recording is off, where **Record GPU history** actually is. - Thanks @veydon for contributing the Simplified Chinese translation in [#20](https://github.com/jaein4722/NVBeacon/pull/20).
